title.zh: Quiet Pantry 电商套图审阅

name.zh: PPV Fixture 柑橘食品柜冲调粉

summary.en: This fictional two-SKU pouch set passed concept-stage QA. GitHub publication is not authorized.
summary.zh: 这套虚构双 SKU 袋装图已通过概念阶段 QA，尚未授权发布到 GitHub。

summary.en: Both sealed pouches appear together on the approved neutral field.
summary.zh: 两款密封袋装共同置于已批准的中性背景上。

identity.en: Pouch geometry, PPV FIXTURE, CITRUS PANTRY MIX, variant names, 240 g, palette, and illustrations remain locked.
identity.zh: 袋型、PPV FIXTURE、CITRUS PANTRY MIX、口味名、240 g、配色与插画均保持锁定。

qa.en: Full-resolution and 320 px inspection passed for identity, copy, object count, and catalog readability.
qa.zh: 完整尺寸与 320 px 检查均通过，包装身份、文案、物体数量和目录识别清楚。

summary.en: A closer crop shows the selected Lemon Ginger package face.
summary.zh: 近景裁切展示已选 Lemon Ginger 包装正面。

identity.en: Copy, geometry, palette, and illustration remain unchanged.
identity.zh: 文案、袋型、配色和插画均未改变。

qa.en: The crop, copy, closure cue, and package-face identity passed at both review sizes.
qa.zh: 裁切、文案、封口特征和包装正面身份在两种审阅尺寸下均通过。

summary.en: One sealed Berry Oat pouch stands beside exactly one empty clear glass.
summary.zh: 一袋密封 Berry Oat 与恰好一个空透明杯并列。

identity.en: The pouch stays sealed. The image adds no powder, drink, dosage, serving, or performance instruction.
identity.zh: 包装保持密封，画面没有新增粉末、饮品、用量、食用或效果说明。

qa.en: Object count, scene state, claims, composite edges, and thumbnail recognition passed.
qa.zh: 物体数量、场景状态、声称、合成边缘和缩略图识别均通过。

summary.en: The approved 240 g source pixels are enlarged beside the complete Lemon Ginger pouch.
summary.zh: 完整 Lemon Ginger 袋装旁放大展示已批准的 240 g 源像素。

identity.en: Only the existing 240 g copy appears. The image adds no dimensions, counts, materials, or legal conclusions.
identity.zh: 画面只展示现有 240 g 文案，没有新增尺寸、数量、材质或法规结论。

qa.en: Source-pixel identity, complete-pouch visibility, and the no-invented-specification rule passed.
qa.zh: 源像素身份、完整包装可见性和不得虚构规格的要求均通过。

summary.en: Both sealed pouches stand on a warm fictional pantry shelf with unbranded props at the edges.
summary.zh: 两款密封袋装置于暖色虚构食品柜层架，无品牌道具位于画面边缘。

identity.en: Both package faces, SKU assignments, copy, and palettes remain locked.
identity.zh: 两个包装正面、SKU 对应、文案与配色均保持锁定。

qa.en: Placement, background provenance, package identity, cross-SKU consistency, and both review sizes passed.
qa.zh: 摆位、背景来源、包装身份、跨 SKU 一致性和两种审阅尺寸均通过。

summary.en: Two pouches form a campaign composition while the left side remains open for later channel copy.
summary.zh: 两款袋装构成活动画面，左侧留给后续渠道文案。

identity.en: The image adds no benefit message, new claim, or package redesign.
identity.zh: 画面没有新增利益点文案、声称或包装重设计。

qa.en: Negative space, two-pouch count, package identity, clean edges, and thumbnail readability passed.
qa.zh: 留白、双包装数量、包装身份、边缘完整性和缩略图识别均通过。

summary.en: One complete Lemon Ginger pouch is placed on a quiet square channel canvas.
summary.zh: 一袋完整 Lemon Ginger 置于克制的方形渠道画布。

identity.en: The square adaptation changes only placement and background. It adds no frame, line, claim, or copy.
identity.zh: 方形适配只改变摆位与背景，没有新增边框、线条、声称或文案。

qa.en: Square crop, safe margin, package identity, artifact integrity, and 320 px recognition passed.
qa.zh: 方形裁切、安全边距、包装身份、成品完整性和 320 px 识别均通过。
